input_fields.name: target_window
input_fields.description: Stable target window identity and observed current state.

input_fields.name: layout_exception
input_fields.description: Declared reason and bounds for an exception that prevents maximization.

result_fields.name: window_state
result_fields.description: Observed final maximized state, bounds, and window identity.

result_fields.name: exception_record
result_fields.description: Empty when maximized; otherwise explicit exception reason and affected interaction.

procedure: Verify target identity and current bounds before sending a maximize command.
Apply one maximize action only when not already maximized; otherwise record the observed state.
If a declared exception is necessary, preserve its bounds and reason instead of forcing maximize.
Re-observe and return window_state plus exception_record.
rejection_rules: Reject a non-unique or non-controllable window.
Reject an undeclared exception; do not reduce the window for convenience.
Do not bundle document activation, script loading, or visual review.
